_comment: Landing page feature cards. build.py renders them into {{feature_cards}} with a roadmap status computed from `owners` (Implementation Order tables); `sources` are the code each card describes. Text states only what the code does today; planned work is named as planned.

cards.title: IXFS and FAT32 Filesystems
cards.text: IXFS, our own filesystem, with journaling, copy-on-write and 64-bit extents, plus FAT32 read and write for USB drives.

cards.title: AHCI and NVMe Storage
cards.text: AHCI with DMA and NCQ command queuing, and a native NVMe driver. A legacy ATA PIO driver remains as a fallback for older machines.

cards.title: Windows 11 Style Desktop
cards.text: Taskbar, Start menu and a compositing window manager with frosted Acrylic surfaces and dirty-rectangle redraw. Mica window title bars are next.
cards.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" width="28" height="28" style="color: var(--accent-cyan);"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M9 17.25v1.007a3 3 0 0 1-.879 2.122L7.5 21h9l-.621-.621A3 3 0 0 1 15 18.257V17.25m6-12V15a2.25 2.25 0 0 1-2.25 2.25H5.25A2.25 2.25 0 0 1 3 15V5.25A2.25 2.25 0 0 1 5.25 3h13.5A2.25 2.25 0 0 1 21 5.25Z"/></svg>

cards.title: SMP Multi-Core
cards.text: Boots every CPU and schedules threads across all of them with a fair round-robin scheduler, plus mutexes, semaphores, RW locks, seqlocks and a basic RCU. Per-CPU run queues and CFS-style fair sharing are planned.

cards.title: Networking
cards.text: Ethernet, ARP, IPv4, ICMP, UDP and DHCP with an RTL8139 driver work today. TCP, DNS and a VirtIO-net driver are planned.

cards.title: UEFI Secure Boot
cards.text: A UEFI-only bootloader with a GOP framebuffer: no legacy BIOS, no VGA text mode. It reads the Secure Boot state and supports shim chain-loading and SBAT, but builds boot directly today: a shim signed under the Microsoft 2023 CA is still pending.
cards.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" width="28" height="28" style="color: var(--accent-cyan);"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M16.5 10.5V6.75a4.5 4.5 0 1 0-9 0v3.75m-.75 11.25h10.5a2.25 2.25 0 0 0 2.25-2.25v-6.75a2.25 2.25 0 0 0-2.25-2.25H6.75a2.25 2.25 0 0 0-2.25 2.25v6.75a2.25 2.25 0 0 0 2.25 2.25Z"/></svg>

cards.title: Windows Registry
cards.text: A Windows-compatible registry with HKLM and HKCU hives, RegOpenKeyEx and RegSetValueEx, saved to disk. Transactions and faster hive storage are in progress.
cards.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M3.75 12h16.5m-16.5 3.75h16.5M3.75 19.5h16.5M5.625 4.5h12.75a1.875 1.875 0 0 1 0 3.75H5.625a1.875 1.875 0 0 1 0-3.75Z"/></svg>

cards.title: SIMD Graphics
cards.text: SSE2-accelerated drawing on the CPU: pre-multiplied alpha blending, gradients, blur, TrueType text and a glyph cache. GPU acceleration is a research item.

cards.title: Win32 SDK
cards.text: A minimal user-mode Win32 header set over native NT system calls today: GetCurrentProcessId, GetTickCount, CreateFileA, ReadFile and CloseHandle. The full Win32 SDK and packaged releases are planned.
